name: ch32-uart0
description: WCH CH32/CH32X series on UART0 connector: RST=GPIO2 (low active). ISP download via WCH-LinkUtility serial mode needs the chip's own bootloader pin; typically prefer LINK1 SWD or WCH-Link.
notes: For CH32 ISP the bootloader pin is sampled at reset; pulse reset with boot asserted.
